tagline: Weapons, armor, artifacts, talismans, enchantments and effects, plus the bestiary, world map and achievements, with the game's own text, comparable with Traditional Chinese.
notFoundBody: This slot is empty. The address may be mistyped, or the entry is not in the wiki yet.
rarityHintNormal: Every item can be Common, Rare, or Special; all three are listed here.
rarityHintUnique: A unique variant is a distinct form of the item, with its own name and appearance.
compatibleEffectsIntro: Effects this item can have when found or rerolled at a blacksmith.
noEffectData: The game data lists no effects for this item.
effectSource: Effect data from the game's data files.
effectSourceManual: The unique effect's value was checked by hand.
artifactStatsNote: Values from the game's data files. Damage, healing and similar numbers live in ability files and are not available yet.
statsNote: Base values from the game's data files; item power raises them in play.
obtainedFromBook: Enchantment books can be used to enchant your items with special powers and abilities. In order to use the enchantment books you will have to travel to Brave Haven and talk to the Enchantsmith. Enchantment books can be used unlimited times.
name: Name
disclaimer: Unofficial fan site, not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. Game text and images belong to their respective owners.
source: Source: Minecraft Dungeons II localization files.
mapIntro: The game's own top-down map, with minecart stations, rifts, the teleport statue, merchants and areas.
mapNeedsJs: JavaScript is needed to zoom the map and see its markers.
mapSource: Map and marker positions come from the game's data files.
achievementsIntro: Every Steam achievement in Minecraft Dungeons II, ordered by global unlock rate from highest to lowest.
achievementsCredit: Achievement icons, names, descriptions and global unlock rates come from Steam (app 1912410); rates as of {date}. © Mojang Studios / Microsoft.
mobsIntro: Hostile mobs of the game, with base stats, known areas and how they drop loot.
mobBaseValues: Base values, before difficulty and party scaling.
mobAreasNote: Based on area spawns and arena waves in the game data; open-world camps are not listed.
mobDropsNote: Compiled from the game data; actual drops may be affected by game mechanics.
mobDropPoolArea: Items come from the area's drop pool.
mobDropPoolOwn: Items come from this mob's own list.
mobDropPoolNone: The data has no item list for this.
mobPortraitCredit: Portraits are renders of the game's models.
mobUnitsNote: Movement speed and sight radius are the game's raw engine values, not blocks or seconds.
sourcesNote: Compiled from the game data; actual drops may be affected by game mechanics.
talismanLevelsNote: Talismans gain XP while equipped and level up. Values come from the game's data files. Companion multipliers are the raw values in those files: a lower defence or cooldown multiplier is likely an improvement (less damage taken, a shorter cooldown), but the exact meaning is unverified.
valuesNotInData: These values are not in the game's data files (shown as ?).
soulStormIntro: Live Soul Storm schedule, area rotation, Storm Generators and reward chests.
soulStormUnverified: Estimated times, not yet confirmed in game
soulStormTimeZone: Times are in your time zone: {zone}
soulStormCadence: A storm starts every {cadence} minutes and lasts {duration} minutes; the areas take turns in the order below.
soulStormNoScript: Turn on JavaScript to see the countdown.
soulStormNoData: There is no schedule data yet.
soulStormUnlockMainQuest: Available after you complete the main story.
soulStormResistances: All three difficulties share these resistances:
soulStormRarity: Per the game data, storm chests weight rarities: Common ×{common}, Rare ×{rare}
soulStormMonstrositiesNote: A Hard Storm Generator summons one of these.
buildIntro: Put together a loadout and share it as a link or an image.
buildLoadFailed: The build planner could not load.
buildCopyFailed: Could not copy. Copy the address below instead.
buildDropped: Items that could not be placed (gone from the game or repeated): {n}
buildUnsupported: This link comes from another version of the planner, so it opened empty.
buildOldVersion: This build was made for game version {old}; the data is now {current}, so some items may have changed.
buildEffectLimit: Up to {n} effects per item, counting a unique item's built-in effect
weaponCompareIntro: Put up to three weapons side by side: damage, fire rate, reach, stagger and the effects they can roll.
weaponCompareDropped: Weapons left out (unknown, repeated or more than 3): {n}
questsIntro: The game's core and side quests, Echo Golem quests and boss replays, with objectives, prerequisites and rewards in the game's own words.
locationsIntro: The game's regions: the places inside them, the monsters found there, their quests and area loot, named as the game data names them.
locationLevelNote: The player level the game's progression table sets for this region.
locationLootNote: Items in this region's area drop pool.
bossesIntro: The game's bosses and mini-bosses in story order, with health, region and the quests that feature them. The game itself has no boss descriptions.
bossesOrder: Order: by the first core quest that features each one; the rest by the lowest player level among their regions, then by name.
